\subsection{Authority and Responsibility of the Executive}
\label{authority-and-responsibility-of-the-executive}

\subsubsection{Executive Authority}
\label{executive-authority}

The Executive has the following authority:

\begin{enumerate}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  To Test this project!
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  To administer the day-to-day business and operations of the MES.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  To act as an advisory board to the MES Council on the effects of the MES Council’s policy decisions on the day-to-day operations of the MES.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  To perform the functions of the MES Council during the summer, subject to any restrictions placed on it by the MES Council.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  In case of an emergency situation where the MES Council is unable to meet, the Executive may make an interim decision, although any policy decisions shall be subject to ratification at the next MES Council meeting.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Approve expenditures not exceeding \$500, unless the expenditure is coming from the Executive Operations account.
  \end{quote}
\end{enumerate}

\subsubsection{Executive Responsibility}
\label{executive-responsibility}

The Executive shall have the following responsibility:

\begin{enumerate}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  To review the MES budget prepared by the VPF for final recommendations to the MES Council.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  To form ad-hoc committees when required for the purpose of appointing members to assist in administering the policies of the MES and undertaking new initiatives.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  To be accountable and transparent for all its actions to the MES Council and to the general membership at each General Meeting.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Initiate and encourage new events and initiatives of the MES.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Supervise appointed MES Team positions to provide advice or assistance.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Liaise with other members or groups within the university community.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Promote professionalism within the MES Team.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Take a proactive role in the long term goal setting of the MES.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Ensure effective transition and continuity between the outgoing Team and the incoming Team, through documentation and orientation.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Create a positive and effective working environment.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Executive members to hold at least 2 hours of scheduled office hours weekly.
  \end{quote}
\end{enumerate}

\subsection{Directors}
\label{directors}

\subsubsection{Director of Events}
\label{director-of-events}

The Director of Events shall:

\begin{enumerate}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Oversee the organization of engineering pub nights and other social events of the MES
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Initiate at least one new activity and ensure the overall schedule of events offers a variety of activities that will appeal to many different groups.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Coordinate with the VPC to promote MES activities.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Provide the Administrator with dates and details of all events and initiatives.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Report to Vice President, Student Life.
  \end{quote}
\end{enumerate}

\subsubsection{Director of Clubs}
\label{director-of-clubs}

The Director of Clubs shall:

\begin{enumerate}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Meet with MES Groups to support them for Affiliation, Ratification or for other reasons as needed.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Provide MES Groups bookings for Hatch Junction and Atrium, Jhe, and ABB Tower space.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Recommend funding levels for all MES funded Clubs and Teams to the Vice President, Finance and Administration and enforce the Funding Policy (see Section \ref{funding-policies}).
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Collaborate with University Health and Safety and ensure all MES Groups abide by its guidelines.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Promote MES flagship by encouraging the use of MES branding amongst MES Groups.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Chair the Club Leaders Committee (see Section \ref{club-leaders-committee}).
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Serve on the Hatch Operations Committee (Faculty Committee).
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Organize Clubsfest to facilitate connections between students and clubs
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Organize and update the MES Groups list and bylaws as needed.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Report to Vice President, Internal.
  \end{quote}
\end{enumerate}

\subsubsection{Director of Operations}
\label{director-of-operations}

The Director of Operations shall:

\begin{enumerate}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Supervise the care and usage of all MES Equipment Rentals (see Section \ref{mes-equipment-rental}).
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Be responmsible for ensuring that MES Groups using the equipment rentals are aware of how to safely handle them.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Ensure all MES Groups renting equipment rentals complete the appropriate forms and provide the appropriate deposits.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Assist VPI and GHC Coordinator(s) in organizing space allocations for MES Clubs and Teams in the Gerald Hatch Centre.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Maintain the MES Google Workspace and the email service and mailing lists
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Take appropriate action ot protecet passwords for the MES mailing lists and any other MES passwords.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Assist VPI on Adhoc matters when necessary.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Report to VPI.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Assist in supervision of the following positions:
  \end{quote}

  \begin{enumerate}
  \item
    \begin{quote}
    DW Lounge Coordinator(s)
    \end{quote}
  \item
    \begin{quote}
    Gerald Hatch Centre Student Coordinator(s)
    \end{quote}
  \item
    \begin{quote}
    Trailer Coordinator(s)
    \end{quote}
  \end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}

\subsubsection{Director of Academic Resources}
\label{director-of-academic-resources}

The Director of Academic Resources shall:

\begin{enumerate}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Organize and advertise all academically related events run by the MES including, but not limited to:
  \end{quote}

  \begin{enumerate}
  \item
    \begin{quote}
    MES Academic Help Sessions (see Section \ref{mes-academic-workshops})
    \end{quote}
  \item
    \begin{quote}
    Technical skills sessions
    \end{quote}
  \end{enumerate}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Be responsible for maintaining all aspects of the McMaster Engineering Society Textbook Library, foremost:
  \end{quote}

  \begin{enumerate}
  \item
    \begin{quote}
    Actively working to procure new textbooks
    \end{quote}
  \item
    \begin{quote}
    Maintaining an updated inventory of all textbooks in the MES’ possession.
    \end{quote}
  \item
    \begin{quote}
    Coordinating with the Drain Coordinators to ensure proper instruction is given to the Drain volunteers on how to run the Textbook Library.
    \end{quote}
  \item
    \begin{quote}
    Cleaning the Textbook Library and ensuring it is kept organized.
    \end{quote}
  \item
    \begin{quote}
    Ensuring all textbooks in the Textbook Library are labelled with the MES logo.
    \end{quote}
  \item
    \begin{quote}
    Ensuring all textbooks are returned to the Textbook Library by the end of each semester.
    \end{quote}
  \end{enumerate}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Recruit upper year students for the Academic Services Committee as ’session leads’ to run MES Academic Help Sessions by mid-September.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Chair the Academic Services Committee (see Section \ref{academic-services-committee})
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Actively seek ways to improve the academically related events and services provided by the MES.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Organize and maintain the Notes/Test Bank.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Organize Textbook Swap during Back2School Week.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Report to Vice President, Academic.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  Be a position held by one person.
  \end{quote}
\end{enumerate}

\subsubsection{Executive Transition Process}
\label{executive-transition-process}

\begin{enumerate}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  The outgoing and incoming Executive shall plan and attend a retreat to make long term plans for the year ahead and carry out a more detailed transition.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  The President is to organize, plan and document the retreat.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  The budget for this retreat shall be set for no more than \$2000, taken from the Executive Operations budget line.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  The incoming Executive shall prepare a presentation for the first Council meeting following the retreat, outlining what was accomplished on the retreat, what the budget was used for, and informing Council of the year’s objectives and long-term goals.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  The Outgoing Executive shall remain engaged with the Incoming Executive over the summer months to impart institutional knowledge, share best practices, and facilitate an effective transition.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  The Outgoing Vice-President Finance shall oversee the year-end closing and ensure the completion of the audit for their fiscal year under their purview.
  \end{quote}
\item
  \begin{quote}
  The Outgoing President and Outgoing Vice-President External Relations shall attend ESSCO PM.
  \end{quote}
\end{enumerate}
